title: Kitab At-Tawheed with Ibn 'Uthaymeen's Commentary (Al-Qawl al-Mufeed)
description: A complete study of Shaykh al-Islam Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Wahhab's Kitab At-Tawheed (the Book of Monotheism), via Imam Ibn 'Uthaymeen's celebrated commentary Al-Qawl al-Mufeed, taught by Ustadh AbdulAziz al-Haqqan in 35 sequential lessons. Kitab At-Tawheed is the foundational Salafi text on the theology of tawheed (monotheism): its rights, obligations, and how to guard against the negations that invalidate it.
short_description: Foundational study of Kitab At-Tawheed with Ibn 'Uthaymeen's commentary

modules.title: Foundations & the Meaning of Tawheed
modules.description: The introduction and opening chapters of Kitab At-Tawheed: what worship is, the three categories of tawheed, and the sincerest statement of tawheed.
